title: Book Two · Chapter 94: Jun's Other Game
story:
On Wednesday, Ronan goes to the yard with the cloth ball. Jun is already there with the other children. They are using another ball for a small team game.

“I am ready,” Ronan says.

Jun looks at the two sides. Each side has three children. Jun is on one side. A child beside the wall is on the other.

“We started before lunch ended.”

“I can go on your side.”

Jun points to the teams. “Then one side has four.”

Ronan holds his own ball tighter. He thought Jun would be waiting. He and Jun often play beside that wall. It almost feels like their own place.

“How long?” he asks.

“Until this round ends.”

Ronan wants to say the game is too crowded anyway. Instead, he sits on the step. Jun returns to his side. The other children do not stop to watch Ronan leave.

Leo comes out of the building. He sees the cloth ball.

“Throw?”

“Jun is playing with them.”

“I can see.”

Leo sits beside Ronan. For a moment, neither speaks. Then a ball rolls out of Jun's game. Ronan stops it near his shoe and sends it back.

“Thanks,” Jun calls.

Ronan raises one hand. He feels a little better. He stands and throws his own ball to Leo. They use the clear space near the other end of the wall.

After a while, a child leaves Jun's game for water. Jun looks toward Ronan and waves.

“Do you want the next turn?”

Ronan looks at Leo. They have just started a new round of their own.

“After this one?”

Jun nods. He waits with the others while Ronan and Leo finish. There is a place for him now. But he does not rush his game with Leo.

Leo throws the next ball a little higher. Ronan catches it and sends it back to finish their round.

Jun does not call again. He is talking to the other players near the wall.

The child who went for water comes back. The teams begin to move into new places.

Ronan picks up his own cloth ball. Leo walks beside him.

“Both of us?” Ronan asks.

Jun counts the children with one hand, then points to each side.

“Four now.”

Ronan puts the cloth ball safely by the bags. They can use the other one for this game.

He does not know everyone on his new side. One child shows him where to stand. Ronan goes there and looks across at Jun.

Jun has turned toward the ball again. Ronan feels his own shoulders loosen. He has a turn to play, and he will need to learn this game as well.

They join for one short round. Ronan runs well, but he does not know every rule. Jun explains one after the ball goes out. Ronan tries again and makes a clean pass to another child.

At the bell, he carries the cloth ball inside. Jun carries the other one. They can play with other children too.

After school, Ronan tells Mum that Jun started without him. Mum asks if he still got a game.

“Two games,” he says.

“Busy afternoon.”

He puts the ball under his chair and begins his reading. A little later, Jun knocks at the green gate. He wants to ask about tomorrow's work. Ronan moves his chair over and makes room. The two boys open their books at the same page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

team＝队；wait＝等待；watch＝观看。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么不能马上加入Jun的队？
2. 他怎样仍然享受下午？

## 读句子

**Jun / points / to the teams.** Jun／指向／两支队伍。
